subject: Calendar entry
text:
Hi,

I looked at the club calendar, and I think we misread the entry. The meeting is not tonight; the note says next Tuesday. I would not cancel your other plans. If you only want the venue, leave a short note in the member group and wait until Saturday. If someone says the room is booked, ask for the booking reference. If nobody replies, assume the time is wrong. Check the shared calendar once more tomorrow before changing anything. Do not mention the old date again.
